Detailed Description

Interface for handling of GPIO pin used for the triggering of the meassurement. GPIO pin should be configured as the output pin.

Note
Initialization and configuration methods are platform dependent. For this reason these methods are not part of the interface.
For the triggering of the measurement is sufficient to implement only write method (read method is not required).
